name: Vending Love
source:
You just moved into a new apartment. It's not the best, but it's yours. Only… for some reason it seems there isn't a lot of people around--but there is an alleyway. 

And a vending machine. 

And a young man speaking to it.

[From [url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/vending-love]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你刚刚搬进新公寓。它不是最好的，但它是你的。只是……不知道为什么，周围人似乎不多——但有一条小巷。

还有自动售货机。

一个年轻人正在对它说话。

[来自[url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/vending-love]itch.io[/url]]
